description: Golden fixture for generate_channel_unique_id(): aiohomematic's channel/device-level routing key (Channel._unique_id). No parameter; central_id is prepended only for virtual-remote addresses — CUxD channel keys stay bare on both sides, which is why the CUxD cases live here rather than in a divergence file. See aiohomematic_contract/unique_id.py and docs/contract-gaps.md (P1).
